# opsolete_environment_value (Resource)

A project's value for a template's per-environment input (the project's Environment values): every workspace of the project runs with it, and its forms show it read-only. Admins and operators of the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every workspace of the project deploys this template in its subscription's region.
resource "opsolete_environment_value" "region" {
  project_id  = opsolete_project.prd.id
  template_id = "storage-account"
  input       = "location"
  value       = "swedencentral"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input` (String) The input's name; the template marks it per environment.
- `project_id` (String)
- `template_id` (String) The template's id in the catalog.
- `value` (String) As the input takes it: `7`, `true`, an option's value. Checked by the input's rules (type, options, pattern).

### Optional

- `keep_own` (Boolean) Workspaces with a value of their own keep it (one saved before, or what an import found); the others take this one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <project_id>/<template_id>/<input>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opsolete_environment_value.region <project_id>/<template_id>/<input>
```
